# Introduction

This week is the transition point between the mini individual project and the final team project.

# Learning goals

1. Reflect on the mini project experience

2. Understand the expectations for the final project

3. Prepare for working with real-world agricultural data

# Lecture / Lab / Discussion - TBD

Fall Break. 

Discussion: we will test our final product of the mini project on the hold out IDs that can be found on Canvas. You can check your models accuracy as if it is at a farm using this [website](https://bovi-analytics.github.io/check_id_challenge/). Please reflect on your accuracy, the suitability of your model to predict the labels of this set and how good of an indicator this is for industry readiness.  

# Looking ahead

Next week we will officially **kick off the final project**, establish teams and project goals, and visit a farm to understand agricultural data collection in practice.
